verdict.label: FAIL for the rule as encoded in PRE_REG.md on its powered family (15m, asia / london / ny, signal and retest entry): 0 of 6 cells have net > 0, all six nets are -0.12 to -0.15 % per trade with day-clustered CIs entirely below zero. FAIL means stop: it says nothing about 1h / 4h / late (underpowered, descriptive), other band settings, other targets or stops, discretionary reads, other symbols or a bear regime (none in this DEV window).

why: The gate does nothing: 15m all sessions range n 4256 net -0.130 % [-0.161, -0.099] vs ungated n 5311 net -0.127 % [-0.154, -0.099], difference t -0.5.
Gross return is zero within noise and the opposite band is reached in about one trade in five, against about one in three needed to break even on a 2:1 bracket before cost.
Not shown: that the move never happens, only that it does not pay this bracket after 0.14 %; a take-the-mid exit, a trend-inside-range tag or a maker cost (0.09 %) are untested (new PRE_REG).
